inputs.name: renderAudit.findings
inputs.description: The findings to print, in the order given, with no sorting, filtering or field validation; each is written as `path [rule]` with its message on an indented line below. An empty array is valid and makes the function return the fixed passed message instead of a list.

examples.message: TSX/JSX component files should use PascalCase names.
File has 512 lines. Limit is 220. Split it by responsibility.

inputs.name: renderAuditCoverage.result
inputs.description: The complete audit result that the coverage report is built from: `findings` is printed first, then `coverage.profile`, each `coverage.adapters` entry (its `id`, the number of `files`, its `extensions` and its `optionalTools`; `label` is not printed), the count of `coverage.ignoredFindings`, and the lists `coverage.unknownFiles` and `coverage.ignoredPaths`. Only these fields are read, so `cleanCode` and `coverage.coveredFiles` never change the output.

findings.message: File has 512 lines. Limit is 220. Split it by responsibility.

ignoredFindings.message: TSX/JSX component files should use PascalCase names.

outputs.name: renderAudit
outputs.description: The findings text: the fixed line 'Harness audit passed. Files and functions are staying small.' when there are no findings, otherwise one `path [rule]` line and an indented message line per finding, with findings separated by one blank line. It never ends with a newline, and renderAuditCoverage begins its text with it.
examples: Harness audit passed. Files and functions are staying small.

outputs.name: renderAuditCoverage
outputs.description: The renderAudit text followed by a 'Harness audit coverage' header that names the profile, then the covered adapters, the ignored-findings count, the unknown files and the ignored paths; the ignored-findings line, the unknown files list and the ignored paths list print 'none' when empty. The header follows the findings text directly, with no blank line between them.
